objective: Fail a targeted test if production runtime reintroduces static country truth, V1 state, or direct static map projection data paths.
notes: The guard scans non-test src files and rejects static country metadata imports outside the V2 seed bootstrap and unused legacy lookup module, all production country-index/V1 imports, and static country geometry or capital runtime URLs.

WorldMap's three existing label GeoJSON URLs remain permitted only as a named seed cache consumed through projectLabelMapSources and its revisioned output. Directly applying seed label data to MapLibre is rejected.
This stage adds a guard only; it does not redesign label projection or rewrite map rendering.
